author: Confucius
explanation: Prudence and self-restraint protect the soul from the costly pitfalls of recklessness. By deliberating carefully and observing boundary lines, one walks through life with few regrets.
practicalInsight: Avoid signing contracts, making agreements, or replying to heated messages without giving yourself an overnight buffer.
reflectionPrompt: Where has rushing into quick decisions caused avoidable friction in your past?
